byteward.sentence: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 electric cars.
The company says a software flaw can cut power to the motors while the car is moving.
The recall covers Pavane SUVs from the 2025 and 2026 model years.
Quarrow will fix the problem with a free over-the-air update.
The company says it knows of three minor crashes linked to the flaw.

launch-desk.sentence: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 of its electric cars.
Roughly 6,000 cars will have to visit a dealer instead.
Quarrow expects the recall to cost about $9 million.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: According to Quarrow, it only happens when the battery is colder than -10 °C.
About 6,000 early cars have older modems that can't download it, so they'll need a dealer visit.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Quarrow Motors filed a recall covering 80,000 electric cars with the Office of Vehicle Safety on Monday.
The office had been investigating the problem since August.
The filing says the power loss only occurs when the battery is below -10 °C.
In a separate filing to investors, Quarrow estimated the recall's cost at $9 million.
Owner notification letters will go out starting January 8.
